passive.name: Living Battery
passive.description: Zeri's Attacks deal magic damage and are treated as Abilities. Moving and casting Burst Fire stores up energy in Zeri's Sparkpack. When fully charged her next Attack deals bonus damage.

spells.name: Burst Fire
spells.description: Zeri fires a burst of rounds that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation ActiveDamageThatCanCrit was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Ultrashock Laser
spells.description: Zeri fires an electric pulse that deals physical damage and Slows the first enemy hit by % for seconds. If the pulse hits terrain, it expands into a laser that applies the effects in an area and Critically Strikes champions and monsters for physical damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Spark Surge
spells.description: Zeri dashes a short distance and vaults over any terrain she touches, greatly extending the dash range. For the next seconds, her shots of Burst Fire pierce dealing % damage to enemies after the first and an additional magic damage On-Hit to the first target struck. Hitting an enemy with an Attack reduces this Ability's cooldown by seconds. Critical strikes reduce the cooldown by seconds instead.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation BonusDamageTotal was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Lightning Crash
spells.description: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits an enemy champion, Zeri gains % Attack Speed and % Move Speed for seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability extends this ability's duration and adds a stack of Overcharge for seconds. Critical strikes add 2 additional stacks. Each stack grants % Move Speed. During this time, Burst Fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains physical damage to nearby enemies.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalActiveDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
